threat_event: Ransomware spreads from the corporate directory to the gas measurement servers and encrypts them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Measurement servers joined to the corporate directory; directory administrators can log on to them
existing_controls: EDR; immutable backups; database replica in Louisiana
treatment_plan: Block directory administrator logons by 2026-10-31; dedicated measurement enclave by 2027-06-30 (POAM-007)

threat_event: Prolonged loss of measurement and nominations leads to a precautionary curtailment or segment shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual fallback exercised for 8 hours; contingency plan assumes 24 hours
existing_controls: Estimated volumes allowed under the tariff for short periods
treatment_plan: Write and exercise a 72-hour manual scheduling and measurement procedure (POAM-006)

threat_event: Attacker uses the shared OT remote access gateway to reach the central or regional OT DMZ
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared gateway; 46 stale gateway accounts
treatment_plan: Dedicated Transmission gateway tier; account clean-up (POAM-001, POAM-002)

threat_event: Shared unit control panel passwords at 11 stations are used by someone who no longer needs access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mitigations past the TSA plan schedule
treatment_plan: Complete panel mitigations; notify TSA and request an amendment (POAM-008)

threat_event: TSA inspection finds the approved plan not implemented on schedule and the architecture design review lapsed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Schedule slip without amendment request; review interval passed 2026-05-20; assessment pace 22%
treatment_plan: Architecture design review starts 2026-10-05; assessment schedule resourced (POAM-009)

threat_event: An unsupported station HMI is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 HMIs on an unsupported OS without documented mitigations
treatment_plan: Document mitigations now; replace by 2027-09-30 (POAM-012)

threat_event: A known exploited vulnerability on an OT DMZ server is exploited before it is patched
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6 KEV patches exceeded the plan timeline in 2026
treatment_plan: Fixed KEV patch windows with deviation approval (POAM-012)

threat_event: A required CISA, PHMSA, or FERC notice is missed or late during a cyber incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reporting procedure lacks FERC 260.9 and SSI disclosure reports; night-shift ownership unclear
existing_controls: CISA reporting procedure; PHMSA notice procedure
treatment_plan: Single reporting procedure with named night owners (POAM-005)

threat_event: The leak-detection model misses a leak or floods controllers with false alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No documented validation; threshold changes outside control room change management
existing_controls: Advisory only; computational pipeline monitoring and SCADA alarms remain primary
treatment_plan: Validation and change control (P10; POAM-026)

threat_event: A display or station logic change without point-to-point verification shows controllers wrong data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Point-to-point records incomplete for 3 stations upgraded in 2026-03
treatment_plan: Re-verify points at the 3 stations; record before release (POAM-010)

threat_event: A hurricane disables the primary gas control center
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backup center also in a hurricane-exposed region
treatment_plan: Portable control capability; storm playbook

threat_event: Transmission SSI (implementation plan, assessment results) is disclosed from Integrity Services stores
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI on the IDP and engineering shares without SSI controls
treatment_plan: SSI program in Integrity Services (POAM-019); limit what Transmission shares

threat_event: Controllers do not recognize false SCADA data or loss of SCADA integrity as a cyber-caused abnormal condition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controller training lacks cyber AOC scenarios
treatment_plan: Add 3 cyber AOC scenarios to simulator training (POAM-011)

threat_event: The SCADA vendor or an integrator delivers a compromised update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor updates tested on the test system but signatures not always verifiable for older components
treatment_plan: Require signed packages in the 2027 vendor contract renewal

threat_event: A carrier outage cuts microwave and MPLS links to several stations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Satellite backup has lower bandwidth
existing_controls: Satellite backup at every station; manual operation plan
treatment_plan: Accepted by the division security and compliance lead on 2026-09-15: residual risk Low with satellite backup

threat_event: GPS time signals are spoofed and SCADA timestamps drift
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single time source type
treatment_plan: Accepted on 2026-09-15: drift alarms detect it and no control action depends on timestamps

threat_event: An investigation cannot reconstruct activity older than 90 days at the regional OT DMZs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Regional DMZ firewalls keep 90 days; plan requires 1 year
treatment_plan: Forward full firewall logs to the archive (POAM-013)

threat_event: An intrusion at one of the 5 stations without OT sensors goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No passive monitoring at 5 stations
treatment_plan: Install sensors (POAM-003)

threat_event: An intruder at an unmanned compressor station connects to the station network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote stations; video monitored centrally
treatment_plan: Alarm on station switch port changes

threat_event: Shipper accounts on the nominations platform are taken over or the platform is flooded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing portal
treatment_plan: Risk-based sign-in for shipper accounts

threat_event: Gas control staff are phished and their business credentials stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Controllers use business email on separate desks
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for all gas control staff

threat_event: A disgruntled engineer alters station logic
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Engineers hold change rights in windows
treatment_plan: Two-person approval for logic changes

threat_event: Failover to the backup gas control center fails during a real event
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Yearly test only
treatment_plan: Twice-yearly partial failover drills

threat_event: Flow computer data is altered to misstate custody volumes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flow computer configuration changes are logged locally
treatment_plan: Configuration hash checks for flow computers

threat_event: A nation-state actor pre-positions in the Transmission OT DMZs using legitimate tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Living-off-the-land techniques; baseline deviation alerts missing on 4 external connections
treatment_plan: Baseline-deviation alerts; twice-yearly hunts (POAM-003)

threat_event: CEII in FERC filings is mishandled internally
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: CEII marking procedure informal
treatment_plan: Marking and storage rule in POL-04

threat_event: The leak-detection model package is tampered with in the data platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Training runs on a shared platform
existing_controls: Signed packages; hash check before deployment
treatment_plan: Separate training workspace for safety-relevant models

threat_event: Remote valve commands are spoofed on legacy SCADA protocols
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy protocols cannot authenticate commands; network isolation compensates
treatment_plan: Secure protocol upgrade in the 2027-2029 SCADA roadmap
